Patch updates are now managed by the patcher. A small purple/lilac popup at startup opens the patcher when compatible updates are available, after setup and unlocking.

- Remove the in-app update checker and patch download controls.
- Keep mod preferences and installed patch versions in cloud sync; use the patcher to install updates on each device.
- Show a useful message if the patcher is not installed.

Use patcher v0.5.1 or later to prepare and install patch updates.
